<?php
function shift202() { global $later, $next; $later = $next; $next = null; echo "SHIFT;"; return 7; }
class Base202 { public function __call(string $name, array $arguments) { global $later; $later = 99; return new class($arguments) { public function __construct(public array $saved) {} public function __destruct() { echo "CHILD;"; } }; } public function __destruct() { echo "OWNER;"; } }
class Derived202 extends Base202 {}
$next = null; $owner = new Derived202; $child = $owner->MiSsInG(shift202(), $later); unset($owner); echo ($child->saved[0] === 7 && $child->saved[1] === null) ? "OK;" : "BAD;"; unset($child, $later);
$later = false; $alias =& $later; $next = true; $owner = new Derived202; $child = $owner->MiSsInG(shift202(), $later); unset($owner); echo ($child->saved[1] === true && $alias === 99) ? "OK;" : "BAD;"; unset($child, $alias, $later);
$prefix = "REQUEST"; $next = $prefix . "-NEW"; $later = "OLD"; $owner = new Derived202; $child = $owner->MiSsInG(shift202(), $later); unset($owner); echo $child->saved[1] === "REQUEST-NEW" ? "OK;" : "BAD;"; unset($child, $later); echo "AFTER;";

$later = 1; $alias =& $later; $next = 42; $child = Derived202::MiSsInG(shift202(), $later); echo ($child->saved[0] === 7 && $child->saved[1] === 42 && $alias === 99) ? "OK;" : "BAD;"; unset($child, $alias, $later);
$later = 2.0; $next = -0.0; $child = Derived202::MiSsInG(shift202(), $later); echo (string)$child->saved[1] === "-0" ? "OK;" : "BAD;"; unset($child, $later); echo "AFTER;";

<?php

class Derived202 extends Base202 {}
$later = "OLD"; $alias =& $later; $next = "BYTE\x80"; $owner = new Derived202; $child = $owner->MiSsInG(first:shift202(), later:$later); unset($owner); echo ($child->saved["first"] === 7 && $child->saved["later"] === "BYTE\x80" && $alias === 99) ? "OK;" : "BAD;"; unset($child, $alias, $later);
$later = true; $next = false; $owner = new Derived202; $child = $owner->MiSsInG(first:shift202(), later:$later); unset($owner); echo $child->saved["later"] === false ? "OK;" : "BAD;"; unset($child, $later); echo "AFTER;";

<?php
function shift202() { global $later, $owner; $later = new Payload202; $owner = null; echo "SHIFT;"; return 7; }
class Payload202 { public function __destruct() { echo "LEAF;"; } }
class Base202 { public function __call(string $name, array $arguments) { global $later; $later = null; echo "HANDLER;"; return new class($arguments) { public function __construct(public array $saved) {} public function __destruct() { echo "CHILD;"; } }; } public function __destruct() { echo "OWNER;"; } }
class Derived202 extends Base202 {}
$later = new Payload202; $owner = new Derived202; $child = $owner->MiSsInG(shift202(), $later); echo "RETURN;"; echo $child->saved[1] instanceof Payload202 ? "HELD;" : "BAD;"; unset($child); echo "AFTER;";
